The '''Desolation Plains''' was the name given icy plains that lay north of [[Brightmirror Road]] in the [[Whiterock Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Icequake Ridge]] was located on the southern edge of the plains.
